Content: A premium television network launches a new standalone streaming app. They charge a flat digital processing fee of `$12` to set up an account, and a recurring subscription fee of `text($15 per month)`.
Create a linear equation that represents the total cost, `y`, in `text(dollars)`, a user will pay for a subscription lasting `x` `text(months)`.
A gourmet food truck vendor pays a flat fee of `text($75 each day)` to park at a city festival. The vendor sells artisan grilled cheese sandwiches for `$12` each.
If the vendor's net profit at the end of a single day is represented by `y` and the number of sandwiches sold is represented by `x`, create an equation that models this situation.

A freelance graphic designer takes on a brand strategy project for a local business. The client pays a contract deposit of `$450` before any work begins. In addition to this deposit, the designer bills the client an `text(hourly)` rate of `$55` for the design labor.
Create an equation that represents the total amount of money, `y`, in `text(dollars)`, the client owes the designer after `x` `text(hours)` of work.

An online retail warehouse starts the morning shift with a baseline of `text(3,200)` packages already processed and stacked on pallets awaiting delivery trucks. Throughout the shift, delivery trucks take out packages at a constant rate of `text(240 packages per hour)`.
Create an equation that represents the total number of processed packages, `y`, in the warehouse after the automated system has run for `x` `text(hours)`.
Marcus receives a `$150` prepaid digital gift card to an online bookstore as a graduation present. He uses the card to purchase premium audiobooks that cost a flat rate of `$14` each.
Create an equation that models the remaining balance, `y`, in `text(dollars)`, on Marcus's gift card after he purchases exactly `x` audiobooks.

A bakery sells large custom event cakes for `$85` each. If a customer wants the cakes delivered directly to their venue, the bakery charges a single flat delivery and handling fee of `$30` for the trip.
Create an equation that represents the total cost, `y`, in `text(dollars)`, for a customer who orders `x` custom cakes and has them delivered together.
A gourmet food truck operator pays a flat fee of `text($120 per day)` to park their vehicle at a local food festival. The truck sells its signature brisket plates for `$16` each.
Create an equation that models the food truck's net profit, `y` in `text(dollars)`, on a single festival day from selling `x` brisket plates.

A non-profit organization hosts a 5K race to raise money for a community garden. Before the registration window opens, a local business makes a lump-sum donation of `$800` to anchor the event. For every individual runner who registers for the race, the charity collects an entrance fee of `$35`.
Create an equation that represents the total money raised, `y`, in `text(dollars)`, if `x` runners register for the event.

A commercial aircraft is cruising at an initial altitude of `text(36,000 feet)` when the pilot receives permission to begin a gradual descent toward the destination airport. The airplane descends at a perfectly constant rate of `text(900 feet per minute)`.
Create an equation that models the aircraft's current altitude, `y`, in `text(feet)`, exactly `x` `text(minutes)` after the descent begins.

A coffee shop chain rolls out a new loyalty app to encourage morning orders. On the first day of the campaign, the app launches with `300` active profiles created during beta testing. Over the next several weeks, new users create profiles at a constant rate of `text(45 people per day)`.
Create an equation that models the total number of active user profiles, `y`, exactly `x` `text(days)` after the app's official launch.
